title: Capstone – multi-platform, multi-architecture disassembly framework
summary: Capstone is a lightweight, multi-platform disassembly framework that supports dozens of CPU architectures including x86, ARM, MIPS, and PowerPC. It provides a unified API for disassembling machine code and is widely used in reverse engineering, security analysis, and binary analysis tools.
problem_solved: Enables developers to disassemble machine code across multiple platforms and architectures without writing architecture-specific parsing logic.
why_valuable: It serves as the disassembly backbone for many security tools like radare2, CNG, and various malware analysis frameworks, accelerating development of binary analysis tools.
